preconditions.description: The number of glades in the park is between 1 and 10^6, inclusive.
The number of trails in the park is between 0 and 10^6, inclusive.
Each trail connects two glades within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.description: The output is either 0 if Vasya's walk is possible, or the minimum number of trails to be added to make the walk possible.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in trails)
invariants.description: Each trail connects two existing glades within the park.

invariants.expression: all(xi != yi for xi, yi in trails)
invariants.description: No trail connects a glade to itself.

invariants.expression: all(xi != xj or yi != yj for i < j for xi, yi, xj, yj in trails)
invariants.description: No two trails connect the same pair of glades.

invariants.expression: all(all(xi != xj and yi != yj for xj, yj in trails if (xi, yi) != (xj, yj)) for xi, yi in trails)
invariants.description: No trail connects the same pair of glades as any other trail.
